Cc: procurement@clearsight.ai
Date: 2026-02-10T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Sizing for Q3 expansion + contract timing

Hey Jordan —

Quick note as we plan Q3: the engineering team expects to roll a new generative feature in late May that will raise our monthly token consumption by ~20k/month starting June. Our existing contract is on a yearly cadence that renews on 2026-08-31.

Two asks from procurement/engineering:
- Can Redwood provide a simple add-on price for the incremental 20k tokens (monthly vs annualized)?
- If we annualize the add-on, would you be open to co-terming that add-on to our Aug 31 renewal and offer any one-time onboarding/waiver credits?

Attached: Clearsight_Usage_Snapshot_Q1.pdf to show current baseline.

We'd like to get commercial terms before our next exec budget review (week of Feb 22).

Thanks,
Alyssa
Alyssa Moreno
Head of Product Ops, ClearSight AI
alyssa@clearsight.ai

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Moreno <alyssa@clearsight.ai>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-02-11T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Sizing for Q3 expansion + contract timing

Alyssa —

Thanks for the snapshot, that helps. High level options we can move quickly on: 

Option 1 — Monthly add-on (fast):
- Incremental 20k tokens/month charged at list add-on rate $0.0008/token
- No co-term; billed month-to-month.
- No onboarding credit available for monthlies.

Option 2 — Annualize + Co-term (recommended):
- Annualized top-up equivalent to 240k tokens/year; effective blended unit price $0.00068/token (≈15% off list for the top-up).
- Co-term: align new top-up to 2026-08-31 so it renews on your existing date.
- One-time concession: we can offer a 1-month credit applied in the first invoice if you sign the amendment within 21 days.

Additional short-term help:
- We can provide a 2-week trial bump (no charge) after you flip the switch in staging so your team can validate perf and ROI.
- I attached a Draft_Amendment_Clearsight_v1.docx with the two paths modeled.

Next steps I propose:
1) Pick Option 1 or 2 (or tell me if you want something in between).
2) If Option 2, procurement shares PO window and I’ll route the amendment through Legal and Ops.

cc'ing Kimberley to confirm legal/finance expectations on co-terming and credits.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Attach: Draft_Amendment_Clearsight_v1.docx

Jordan —

Appreciate the clear options. Internal decision: authorized to offer a sales concession to close this (goal is to lock the annualized top-up and co-term). Offer details to present to ClearSight: 

- Commercial concession: 20% off list for the first quarter (first 3 months) of the annualized top-up (must sign and commit to annualized top-up and co-term to qualify).
- Standard Option 2 pricing (15% off blended rate) applies beyond the first quarter.
- Approve the 2-week free trial bump.

Condition: Legal needs to sign off on amendment language and the credit application. Finance will expect the 1-month credit to be reflected as a contra-revenue line on the first invoice.

I'm attaching a short internal-approval-note.pdf for records. Jordan, push this through to Alyssa and loop procurement.

Ben Carter
